title: Medieval masterpiece Bayeux Tapestry arrives in London
summary: The Bayeux Tapestry has arrived in London for the first time in more than 900 years after a highly secure and complex journey from France to the British Museum, as FRANCE 24's Rochelle Ferguson-Bouyahi explains.
